other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation Data Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates dataset-wide statistics (e.g., imputation models, frequency maps, rank transformations) on the entire training set before performing cross-validation splits. This leaks validation data into the training folds, making the out-of-fold validation scores overly optimistic.

summary: The agent provides an exceptional, highly sophisticated solution with deep domain-specific feature engineering, robust handling of missing values, and a well-structured weighted ensemble. The only notable issue is a moderate data leakage during cross-validation, as global training statistics (imputation, frequencies, ranks) are computed before the K-Fold splits, which slightly inflates the OOF validation scores.
